title: Door Locks and Passive Entry: Overview
introduction: The doors can receive locking requests through several routes. I think of them as different doorbells ringing for the same service: identifying the request helps you understand the response. This overview separates power locking, mechanical-key locking and passive entry; activation conditions and troubleshooting belong to more detailed operating information.

edits.text: The power lock/unlock feature locks or unlocks the doors in response to a user request from a door lock control switch, the passive entry system or an RKE transmitter. You can also lock the doors mechanically by using a key in the driver door lock cylinder.
edits.why: I separate the request method from the resulting door action. The mechanical key provides another stated locking method alongside the power lock/unlock feature.

edits.text: Passive entry automatically locks or unlocks the doors, or releases the luggage compartment lid latch.
edits.why: Passive entry serves both the doors and the luggage compartment. Releasing the luggage compartment latch is a different action from locking or unlocking the doors.
